releases.body:
Fix: reasoning levels are lower-cased (Zed lists Gemini's as LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, which showed up that way in OpenCode's picker).

npm: `opencode-magpie-models@0.1.1` — the attached tarball is the one published there (sha1 1c9a885bf0413738747e36e44e36e2c247aa88fd).

First release: registers a Magpie provider in OpenCode V2 whose models (names, context/output limits, input types, reasoning levels) come from Magpie's /v1/models, refreshed hourly, with the last list kept for when Magpie is unreachable.

npm: `opencode-magpie-models@0.1.0` — the attached tarball is the one published there (sha1 c62636719c3b7017993ac526efe1db42b84284e1).
